# AI Agents in Practice: The Playbook

Welcome to **AI Agents in Practice**, a curated collection of practical, battle-tested AI agent implementations. This project serves as a technical bridge between raw LLM capabilities and real-world operational value.

## 🎯 The Objective

The goal is to move beyond "chatbots" and explore how autonomous or semi-autonomous agents can handle complex, multi-step workflows. Each theme below contains specific use cases with detailed descriptions and implementation examples.

::: {#themes-listing}
:::
